title: WCL Mining Sirdar Mock Test 13
subtitle: Western Coalfields Limited — Mining Sirdar Recruitment
instructions: Select the best answer for each question

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The DGMS stands for
options: Directorate of General Mining Services
Directorate General of Mine Safety
Department of Geological Mining Services
Directorate of Government Mining Supervision
questions.solution: Directorate General of Mine Safety.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A mine rescue team must respond to an emergency within
options: Within one hour of receiving the complaint call itself now
Within twenty four hours of receiving the call
At any time of the working day shift cycle
As quickly as possible, typically within 15-30 minutes
questions.solution: As quickly as possible, typically within 15-30 minutes.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'withdrawal of supports' during depillaring follows
options: Random removal of the roof supports
Control of all the dust emissions
Specific sequence to ensure worker safety
Support of the mine conveyor belts
questions.solution: Support withdrawal follows specific safety sequences.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act 1952, the manager must report a fatal accident to
options: The office of the workers' union
The office of the local police station
No one at all on the surface
The Chief Inspector within 24 hours
questions.solution: The Chief Inspector must be notified within 24 hours.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system must be equipped with
options: A musical horn or whistle device only
A headlamp or helmet lamp device only
A fuel gauge or fuel indicator only
Communication system between top and bottom
questions.solution: A communication system between top and bottom is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'safety violation report' must include
options: Nature of violation, person(s) involved, section of regulation violated, and action taken
The name of the shopkeeper who was working nearby in the area at that time
The tonnage of the coal that was lost during that whole shift period
The complete plan of the place where the violation was actually found at that time
questions.solution: Nature, person, regulation, and action taken.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A lighting arrestor is used in mines to
options: Improve the power factor of the whole power supply
Measure the current drawn by the whole electrical circuit here
Divert lightning surges to earth and safeguard the circuits
Provide illumination to the underground working place
questions.solution: Protects electrical equipment from lightning surges.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A junction box in a mine must be
options: Left open at all times in all the underground working places here
Flameproof or intrinsically safe as per the zone classification
Painted with the anti-rust paint on the surface
Any box of the very good make and quality in mine area
questions.solution: Flameproof or intrinsically safe per zone classification.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A sirdar must not leave his section without
options: Permission from any other person here
Proper handover to another authorized person
Notifying only the other mine workers
The permission of the workers' union
questions.solution: Proper handover to another authorized person is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'safety culture' in a mine refers to
options: The number of hours worked per each and every mine shift only
The number of persons employed at the face
Shared values, attitudes, and behaviors regarding safety
The grade of the coal that is produced here
questions.solution: Shared values, attitudes, and behaviors regarding safety.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'coal basin' is a
options: A small deposit of the coal seam
The type of the rock that is present
Large depression containing coal deposits
The type of the coal that is found
questions.solution: A coal basin is a large depression with coal deposits.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'shot firing' sequence in underground coal mines follows
options: A predetermined delay interval per hole
Specific sequence to ensure safety and fragmentation
A single simultaneous initiation of all the holes here
A completely random order of firing the holes
questions.solution: Shot firing follows specific sequence for safety and fragmentation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The winding engine must have a
options: A manually wound clock device
Recording device to log operations
No recording device is fitted
A spare set of the winding ropes
questions.solution: A recording device to log operations is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rope speed indicator' must be
options: It is always hidden from the mine engineman
It is fitted only in the mine main winding cage area here
A painted indicator plate on the mine cage
Clearly visible and accurate to within prescribed limits
questions.solution: Clearly visible and accurate within prescribed limits.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A winding engine must be provided with a
options: Device to prevent the cage from overwinding
A much brighter mine headlight lamp
A spare indicator lamp device here
No any safety device fitted in it
questions.solution: A device to prevent overwinding is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing emergency procedures' address
options: The mine canteen and the welfare issues only
No mine emergencies of any kind at all in the mine area
Pipeline bursts, dam failures, and flooding incidents
The daily attendance of the mine workers here
questions.solution: Emergency procedures cover pipeline bursts, dam failures, and flooding.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'coal reserve' estimation considers
options: Seam thickness, quality, and economic viability
The colour of the overburden spoil heap
The distance of the mine from the rail line
The number of persons employed belowground
questions.solution: Reserve estimation considers thickness, quality, and economics.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'power to prohibit employment' in a mine lies with
options: The office of the mine workers' union
The owner of the whole coal mine area
The inspector of mines or the Chief Inspector
The general manager of the whole mine area
questions.solution: The inspector of mines or the Chief Inspector.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'blast pattern' in opencast mines is designed considering
options: The colour of the overburden material
The exact time of the blasting round
Rock type, explosive, and desired fragmentation
The number of persons in the blast crew
questions.solution: Blast patterns consider geology, explosives, and fragmentation goals.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The earth wire in electrical installation is used to
options: The mechanical strength of all the materials
Improve the power factor of the whole mine power supply only
Carry the load current of the whole circuit here
Provide a low resistance path for fault current to earth
questions.solution: Provides a low resistance path for fault current to earth.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: LHD stands for
options: Large Haulage Device
Low Height Dump
Load Haul Dump
Load Haul Delivery
questions.solution: LHD stands for Load Haul Dump.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'offences and penalties' under the Mines Act include
options: A written warning in the mine daily shift register volume only
A verbal warning given to the general mine manager
No any penalty at all is imposed on the manager
Fines, imprisonment, or both for contravention of provisions
questions.solution: Fines, imprisonment, or both for contravention.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A competent electrical supervisor in a mine is responsible for
options: The acoustic properties of the rock and roof surfaces of the whole mine workings
The electrochemical reaction process of the whole mine cell
Supervision, maintenance, and safety of all electrical installations
The chemical resistance of all the mine components used
questions.solution: Supervision, maintenance, and safety of all electrical installations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'coal seam splitting' occurs when
options: The coal seam is crushed at the surface
The coal seam is extracted from the area
The coal seam is burned in the mine area
A single seam divides into two or more seams
questions.solution: Seam splitting occurs when one seam divides into multiple.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'overbreak' in drifting is
options: It is always acceptable in mine workings
It is desirable in every mine drift
Excavation beyond the designed drift profile
A perfectly circular drift profile
questions.solution: Overbreak is excavation beyond the designed profile.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'sub-drilling' in blast holes is done to
options: To save the cost of the explosives
To reduce the ground vibration level
To increase the blast hole depth
Ensure breakage at planned floor level
questions.solution: Sub-drilling ensures proper breakage at the planned floor level.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Stowing materials include
options: Sand, fly ash, stone dust, and other mine waste
The crushed coal from the mine washery
The clay bricks of the very good quality
The mine timber taken from the forest
questions.solution: Sand, fly ash, stone dust, and other mine waste.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'firing order' in a blast is important to
options: Control the direction of throw and minimize vibration
Determine the number of holes in the blast round of firing only
Select the type of the stemming material used
Decide the colour of the blasted rock mass
questions.solution: Controls direction of throw and vibration.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'truss bolting' in underground mines uses
options: Roof bolts of any length in the mine roof area
Boltless support with the long underground mine friction props only
Single bolts without any grout in the mine roof
Bolts connected in a truss configuration for wide span support
questions.solution: Truss bolting connects bolts in truss configuration for wide spans.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar should check that all persons under his charge
options: Are wearing PPE as required
They always carry mobile phones
They are all married men here
They always carry identity cards
questions.solution: All persons must be wearing required PPE.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, the sirdar must not permit
options: Any blasting operation
Overloading of haulage systems
Any work he thinks unsafe
More than one shift
questions.solution: The sirdar must not permit any work he thinks unsafe.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'gas content' of coal depends on
options: The width of the roadways driven
Coal rank, depth, and geological history
The coal consumption of the district
The size of the ventilation fan
questions.solution: Gas content depends on rank, depth, and geological history.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An explosive charge is used in face drilling to
options: It is used for the roof support
It lubricates the drill rods here
Fragment coal or rock for easier loading
It is used for stemming operations
questions.solution: Fragments coal or rock for easier loading.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'peak particle velocity' (PPV) is a measure of
options: Temperature
Wind speed
Blast vibration intensity
Explosive power
questions.solution: PPV measures maximum ground vibration velocity from blasting.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar's duty during blasting includes
options: Counting the number of persons in the whole mine area
Ensuring all persons are removed to a safe distance
Inspecting the condition of the drill machine
Keeping all the cut holes free of the dust
questions.solution: During blasting the sirdar must ensure all persons are at a safe distance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'cable bolt' in mining is used for
options: Deep support in weak roof conditions
To prevent the water ingress into the roadway
Support of the roadway ribs
Very shallow support of the roof area
questions.solution: Cable bolts provide deep support in weak roof conditions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act, the 'Inspector of Mines' is appointed by
options: The Director General of Mines of the area
The general manager of the mine area
The owner of the whole mine property
The Central Government or State Government
questions.solution: Appointed by the Central Government or State Government.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Coal dust explosion is one of the most dangerous hazards in
options: Underground coal mines
Surface mines only
Open cast mines
Quarry mines
questions.solution: Coal dust explosion is most dangerous in underground coal mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The color code for electrical cables in mines helps to
options: Identify voltage levels and functions
Increase the current rating of the circuit
Thermal insulation properties
Mechanical strength of materials
questions.solution: Identifies voltage levels and functions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act, the 'power to make rules' lies with
options: The DGMS
The manager
The Central Government
The owner
questions.solution: The Central Government.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'manriding' in underground mines uses
options: Only the mine winding ropes here
The mine haulage tubs only here
Special transport systems for workers
The mine conveyor belts only
questions.solution: Manriding uses special transport systems for worker movement.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'advancing longwall' method involves
options: Working the long wall coal face without any roof support only
Extracting coal from the boundary towards the shaft
Extracting coal from the shaft area towards the boundary
Leaving all the long wall panels unworked here
questions.solution: Extracting coal from shaft area towards boundary.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'hanging shot' in coal mines is fired when
options: The mine working shift is ending now
The coal is falling from the roof
The coal face is vertical or overhanging
The floor of the roadway is wet
questions.solution: Hanging shots are used when coal face is vertical or overhanging.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar shall ensure that no person works
options: More than six hours of the shift period
During the mine night shift only here
More than eight hours of the shift
Under the influence of intoxicating substance
questions.solution: No person shall work under the influence of intoxicating substance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'anemometer' is used to measure
options: The pressure in the pipelines
The temperature of the mine air
Air velocity in mine roadways
Power measurement only
questions.solution: Measures air velocity in mine roadways.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The minimum incombustible content in stone dust barriers must be
questions.solution: Minimum 75% incombustible content is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must ensure that safety lamps are
options: It is not used underground at all
It is used only at the surface
It is given to any other person
Issued only to authorized persons
questions.solution: Safety lamps are issued only to authorized persons.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'spontaneous combustion' of coal occurs due to
options: Coal reacting with oxygen and generating heat
Absorption of the moisture by the coal seam area
It is not possible in the coal mines
The mechanical friction on the roof
questions.solution: Spontaneous combustion occurs when coal reacts with oxygen.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The dust control plan in a mine must include
options: Only the cleaning of the mine office premises area
Only the treatment of the main gate
A single annual dusting of the workings
Methods of suppression, monitoring, and review
questions.solution: Methods of suppression, monitoring, and review.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'extensometer' in mining is used to measure
options: The temperature of the rock mass
Displacement or convergence of roof/floor
The air velocity in the roadway
The gas concentration in the roadway
questions.solution: Extensometers measure displacement or convergence of roof and floor.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'historical workings' data is important for inundation risk because
options: It is not a mine survey plan at all in the mine area
It shows the age of the mine workings
It indicates the grade of the coal seam
It shows old workings that may be water-logged
questions.solution: Shows old workings that may be water-logged.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'corrective action report' should specify
options: The monthly production figures of the whole coal mine area here
The production target fixed for the whole quarter
What was done, who did it, when it was done, and the result
The names of all the visitors to the mine area
questions.solution: What, who, when, and result.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The maximum number of persons in a man riding car at any time must not exceed
options: Twenty persons at once
The designed safe capacity
The number of the fitted seats
Ten persons carried at once
questions.solution: Must not exceed designed safe capacity.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'steel prop' in underground mines is preferred over timber because
options: It's adjustable, reusable, and has higher capacity
It is much cheaper than all the others
It is much lighter than all the others
It is much more aesthetic in its overall appearance
questions.solution: Steel props are adjustable, reusable, and have higher load capacity.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The safety slogan 'Safety is no accident' emphasizes that
options: Accidents are a matter of bad luck in the mine area
Safety requires deliberate effort and planning
Accidents are always random events here
Accidents cannot be prevented at all
questions.solution: Safety requires deliberate effort and planning.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'strike' of a coal seam refers to
options: The colour of the coal seam at the mine site area only
The thickness of the coal seam at the mine
The chemical composition of the mine coal
Direction of the line of intersection with horizontal
questions.solution: Strike is the direction of the horizontal line on the seam.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The maximum permissible FER for shot firing in coal mines is
questions.solution: FER must not exceed 1.0 for shot firing in coal mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'trim blast' in mining is used to
options: Create smooth final wall with minimal damage
The main production blast of the round
Increase the vibration of the blast
Reduce the cost of blasting operations
questions.solution: Trim blasts create smooth final walls with minimal damage.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Stowing difficulties include
options: A very serious shortage of water at the blasting face site here
No such difficulties are present there at all now
Pipeline blockages, uneven fill, and water management issues
The cost of the stemming material that is used
questions.solution: Pipeline blockages, uneven fill, and water management issues.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The maintenance of face machineries is important to
options: Ensure reliability, safety, and productivity
Decrease the life of the equipment
Increase the fuel consumption of the plant
Increase the breakdowns of the plant
questions.solution: Ensures reliability, safety, and productivity.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'rock bolt' support in a drift is used to
options: To secure the ventilation stoppings
To prevent the water ingress into it
Reinforce the rock by anchoring loose blocks
To support the mine conveyor belts
questions.solution: Reinforces rock by anchoring loose blocks.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system must be examined by a competent person
options: At intervals prescribed by the manager
Once every six months only here
Whenever the system fails suddenly
Whenever the passengers complain here
questions.solution: At intervals prescribed by the manager.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'support density' in underground mines is determined by
options: Roof conditions, span, and depth of cover
To support the conveyor belts only
The colour of the coal seam here
It is arbitrarily decided in each mine
questions.solution: Support density depends on roof conditions, span, and depth.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'air blast' in underground mining occurs when
options: It affects the roof supports of the whole underground mine area
It is used for the normal mine ventilation
Sudden release of compressed air from goaf or workings
It is used for drilling the blast holes only
questions.solution: Air blasts occur when compressed air suddenly releases from goaf.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'dip' of a seam affects
options: The colour of the coal seam at the mine site
The thickness of the overburden layers at the mine site area
The number of the boreholes that are drilled
The method of working, haulage, and drainage requirements
questions.solution: Method of working, haulage, and drainage requirements.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Mine surveying is essential for
options: Selection of the ventilation fan rating for the whole mine area only
Detection of the firedamp in the mine roadways
Appointment of the mine safety officer only here
Ensuring correct alignment, level, and position of workings
questions.solution: Ensures correct alignment, level, and position of workings.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'gas bar' reading in mines indicates
options: Pressure of the gases only
Temperature of the strata only
Pressure head of gas in boreholes
The ash content of the coal seam
questions.solution: Gas bar readings indicate pressure head of gas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mine survey records' must be
options: Maintained in prescribed format and preserved
It is maintained verbally only in the mine area
It is not maintained in any form here
It monitors the gas concentrations only
questions.solution: Survey records must be maintained and preserved.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The winding engine must not be used for
options: Winding the water out from the bottom of the mine sump area
Winding the coal in the mine haulage tubs
Winding the persons in the mine winding cage
Winding materials if it affects the safety of persons
questions.solution: Must not be used if it affects the safety of persons.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'emergency pumping' capacity in mines should be
options: It is rated only for the dry weather
It has no emergency pumping capacity
Available to handle unexpected large inflows
It is rated for the normal inflow only
questions.solution: Emergency pumping must handle unexpected large inflows.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar is responsible for ensuring that
options: Only after the work is completed
Proper support is set before work proceeds
Only when the mine overman asks for it
As per the choice of the workers here
questions.solution: Proper support must be set before work proceeds.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must check the working place for gas using
options: A flame safety lamp and/or gas detector
A simple electric torch of mine
Reduces air velocity below limits
A surveyor's tape of the mine area
questions.solution: Gas detection requires a flame safety lamp and/or gas detector.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'non-electric detonator' or 'shock tube' system is used because
options: It allows a much longer delay interval in the round here
It is safer near electrical equipment and lightning
It reduces the cost of the detonators used
It can be fired by an electric current
questions.solution: Safer near electrical equipment and lightning.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'break-even strip ratio' means
options: When stripping cost equals mineral value
The mine closure point is reached
Maximum profitable strip ratio
The maximum extraction of the seam
questions.solution: Break-even is when stripping cost equals mineral value.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'swell factor' of excavated material matters because
options: Blasted rock occupies more volume than in-situ
It determines the colour of the rock
It has no practical significance in the mine area
It affects the truck volume capacity
questions.solution: Swell factor accounts for increased volume after excavation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'priming' of an explosive charge involves
options: Drilling of all the blast holes in the round of firing here
Inserting the detonator into the explosive cartridge
Removal of the stemming material from the hole
Counting the number of holes in the round
questions.solution: Inserting detonator into the cartridge.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'PPE' for opencast workers must include
options: A cotton uniform for all the mine workers
Hard hat, safety boots, hi-vis vest, eye/ear protection
A pair of the leather gloves for the workers
A rain coat for all the underground mine working staff only
questions.solution: PPE includes hard hat, boots, hi-vis, eye/ear protection.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing environmental monitoring' includes
options: Water quality, surface stability, and dust levels
Only the daily output figures of mine
Only the colour of the sand that is used in the mine
The brand of the mine water pumps only
questions.solution: Environmental monitoring covers water, stability, and dust.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system must be examined
options: Once a month
Daily before use
Once a year
Only after an accident
questions.solution: Daily examination before use is mandatory.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'powder factor' in coal mine blasting is expressed as
options: The cost incurred per blast round
Kg per cubic meter of rock
Number of holes per blast
The time taken per blast round
questions.solution: Powder factor is the weight of explosive per cubic meter of rock broken.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'women employment' in coal mines has been
options: Gradually increasing in non-underground roles
It is constant over the years here
It is steadily falling in all roles
It is now prohibited everywhere in the coal mines
questions.solution: Gradually increasing in non-underground roles.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: If '−' means '×', '×' means '+', and '+' means '−', find the value of: 6 − 4 × 2
questions.solution: Replacing each symbol: 6 − 4 × 2 becomes 6 × 4 + 2. Applying BDM, 6 × 4 = 24, then 24 + 2 = 26.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'environmental impact assessment' (EIA) for mining includes
options: A survey of the mineral rights in the mine area
A list of all the surface owners of the whole mining region here
A mineral map of the whole mining region here
Study of flora, fauna, water, air, and socio-economic impact
questions.solution: Study of flora, fauna, water, air, and socio-economic impact.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana' provides
options: Subsidised coal supply to the households
Subsidised coal to steel plants
Loans for the highway construction work
Financial inclusion through bank accounts
questions.solution: Financial inclusion through bank accounts.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'National Infrastructure Pipeline' benefits coal sector through
options: Reduced excise duty on the mine coal output here
Improved transport and logistics infrastructure
A river interlinking project only here
Import duty free mining equipment only
questions.solution: Improved transport and logistics.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Money doubles in 5yr at SI. Rate?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The minimum age to become a member of Lok Sabha is
options: 25 years
21 years
18 years
30 years
questions.solution: Minimum age is 25 years.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Who first walked on the moon?
options: Buzz Aldrin
Michael Collins
Neil Armstrong
Yuri Gagarin
questions.solution: Neil Armstrong was first to walk on moon.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A pie chart shows waste composition: Rock=50%, Soil=30%, Coal=10%, Others=10%. If total waste is 1000 tonnes, how much rock?
questions.solution: 50% of 1000 = 500 tonnes.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Indian coal demand' is primarily driven by
options: Thermal power generation
Chemical industry
Exports of coal
The steel industry
questions.solution: Thermal power generation.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Central Coalfields Limited' (CCL) is headquartered at
options: Ranchi
Kolkata
Patna
Dhanbad
questions.solution: CCL is headquartered at Ranchi.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The first woman to go to space was from
options: India
Russia/USSR
China
USA
questions.solution: Valentina Tereshkova was the first woman in space.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Which ocean lies between Africa and Australia?
options: Pacific
Indian
Arctic
Atlantic
questions.solution: Indian Ocean lies between Africa and Australia.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The Olympics 2020 were held in
options: Rio de Janeiro
Tokyo
Beijing
London
questions.solution: Olympics 2020 were held in Tokyo.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Who wrote 'Origin of Species'?
options: Charles Darwin
Isaac Newton
Gregor Mendel
Albert Einstein
questions.solution: Charles Darwin wrote Origin of Species.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'National Mineral Inventory' is maintained by
options: IBM (Indian Bureau of Mines)
The DGMS safety inspectorate office
The Ministry of Coal of the state
The CIL head office at the centre
questions.solution: IBM maintains the National Mineral Inventory.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'mine developer cum operator' (MDO) model involves
options: Transferring the whole mine to the State agency here
Leasing of the coal washeries only here
Hiring a contractor to develop and operate a mine
Nationalising all the private coal mines
questions.solution: Hiring contractor to develop and operate.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'board and pillar' method is also known as
options: Longwall mining only
Surface miner method
Room and pillar method
Shaft sinking only
questions.solution: Also known as room and pillar method.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Indian coal' has higher ash content compared to imported coal because of
options: The size of the coal wagons that are used in the mine
There is no particular reason for this
The method of the coal washing that is used
The geological formation and seam characteristics
questions.solution: Geological formation and seam characteristics.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'opencast to underground' ratio in Indian coal mining is approximately
questions.solution: India's coal mining is predominantly opencast (approximately 90:10).
